purpose: Teach: 岩波書店/ワーキング/大学院生/読了/セーブ/日弁連/コンディション/クラッシュ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、岩波書店との共同企画を進めろ
lines.en: Move forward with the joint project with Iwanami Shoten.
lines.style: Crisp, authoritative opening. No inflection—statement of fact delivered at steady pace. Direct eye contact. The voice of someone accustomed to being obeyed without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ワーキングペーパーを社内で共有します
lines.en: Understood. I'll share the working paper with the team.
lines.style: Respectful, immediate compliance. Measured tempo. Slightly forward-leaning posture in the voice—ready to execute. Not deferential, but clearly in service of the directive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、大学院生のインターンも受け入れろ
lines.en: We're also taking on graduate student interns. Make it happen.
lines.style: Same authority as the first line. Slight pause after the period—letting the weight land. No softening. The tone of someone who has already thought through the implications.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報告書の読了確認を社員に求めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the team confirm they've reviewed the report.
lines.style: Quick, efficient confirmation. Slightly faster pace than before—showing he's already moving on it. Still respectful but energetic. The voice of someone taking mental notes in real time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: データのセーブを毎日必ずしろ
lines.en: Data backups happen every single day. Non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, no room for interpretation. Clipped at the end. Weight on 'every' and 'single'—emphasis through precision, not volume. Quiet intensity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日弁連の見解にも目を通します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also review the JFBA guidelines.
lines.style: Rapid acknowledgment. Slightly breathless—keeping pace with the mounting directives. Still competent, but now showing the load is accumulating. Forward momentum without losing composure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のコンディションを管理しろ
lines.en: Monitor your team's wellbeing. That's on you.
lines.style: Shift in register—more personal, less transactional. Slower delivery. Weight on 'on you'—not blame, but clear assignment of responsibility. A moment where the manager becomes slightly more human.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバークラッシュ対策を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our server backup protocols.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Voice settles into a steady, almost relieved rhythm—the end of a long list. Still professional, but now with a note of quiet resolution. Not trailing off, but landing clearly.
